title: Best Ceiling Fan Under ₹2,000 in India (2026): Top Budget Picks That Actually Cool
description: Compare the best ceiling fans under ₹2,000 in India by airflow, BEE rating, motor warranty and noise — five picks for Indian bedrooms and one to skip.
short_desc: Five budget ceiling fans that out-cool their price tag, ranked by CMM and service network.

headings.text: What actually matters in a ceiling fan under ₹2,000

cta.headline: Warranty terms separate the 5-year and 1-year fans
cta.sub: Two fans at the same price can have wildly different warranty coverage. Compare the motor warranty (not just product warranty) before you decide.

faq.q: Are ceiling fans under ₹2,000 any good?
faq.a: Yes. Brands like Crompton, Orient, Havells and Usha make solid budget fans with 5-star BEE ratings and 2-5 year motor warranties. The cheap unbranded ₹700 fans are the ones to avoid.

faq.q: What is the difference between a 3-star and 5-star ceiling fan?
faq.a: A 5-star BEE-rated fan uses about 30-40% less electricity than a 3-star one. On a fan that runs 16 hours/day, that saves ₹500-₹800/year on your bill.

faq.q: Should I buy a BLDC fan under ₹2,000?
faq.a: Genuine BLDC fans under ₹2,000 are rare — most are ₹2,500+. In this price band, look for a regular induction motor with a 5-star BEE rating; you'll get the best airflow per rupee.

faq.q: What is the right sweep size for an Indian bedroom?
faq.a: 1200mm (48-inch) sweep is standard for rooms up to 150 sq ft. For rooms above 150 sq ft, use a 1400mm (56-inch) sweep or two fans. Smaller rooms (under 80 sq ft) can use 900mm fans.

faq.q: How long do budget ceiling fans last?
faq.a: Reputed brand budget fans (Crompton, Orient, Havells, Usha, Polycab) last 8-12 years with normal use. Unbranded fans can fail in 2-3 years due to bearing issues.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Crompton HS Plus 48-inch at ₹1,549 — it delivers 230 CMM airflow at 52 W with a class-leading 5-year motor warranty. For bulk buyers fitting 4-5 fans at once, the Usha Striker Galaxy 1200mm at ₹1,249 saves ₹1,500+ over the Crompton and still pulls 200 CMM.
key_takeaways: Crompton HS Plus is the benchmark — 230 CMM at 52 W with 5-year motor warranty.
BEE 5-star saves ~₹700/year vs 3-star on a fan running 16 hours/day.
Motor warranty matters more than product warranty — look for explicit 4-5 yr motor coverage.
Sweep size matters: 1200mm for 150 sq ft rooms, 1400mm for larger halls.
who_for: Anyone fitting new ceiling fans in a 1-3 BHK flat, builders buying in bulk for a new project, or renters replacing an old fan on a ₹2,000 budget.
methodology: We compared ceiling fans available on Amazon India and Flipkart under ₹2,000. For each model we verified CMM airflow at top speed, BEE star rating and actual wattage, motor warranty vs product warranty, and service network reach across metro and tier-2 cities. We also tested for wobble at high speed and motor smoothness.
